simple.summary: דְּאָבָה (dᵉʼâbâh) means properly, pining ; by analogy, fear First listed occurrence: Job 41 14.

definitions.full: H1670. deabah דְּאָבָה noun feminine faintness, failure of mental energy, dismay Job 41:14 דְּאָבָה תָּדוּץ וּלְפָנָיו and before him (i.e. the crocodile) danceth dismay .
